skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the scientific basis of urban and rural development planning, including objectives, requirements, and content. Be able to analyze and forecast scenarios in urban and rural development planning.
Develop skills in communication, teamwork, decision-making, and problem-solving in urban and rural development planning.
Understand the social responsibility and importance of urban and rural development planning, and be able to work independently and adapt to different contexts.
Analyze and evaluate urban and rural development plans, and propose solutions for common issues.
Propose and implement urban and rural development strategies, and manage resources effectively.
Understand and apply principles of sustainable urban and rural development.
Communicate effectively about urban and rural development plans and strategies.
Collaborate effectively in teams to develop and implement urban and rural development plans.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Urban and Rural Development Problem Solving
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Solve problems related to urban and rural development planning and implementation.
Evaluate the effectiveness of urban and rural development plans and strategies.
